body: Curb is physical: one static convex-prism collider per block (top at city.ron roads.curb_height), PlayerSpawn.y = curb height. Rejected: visual-only raised sidewalk (player/NPC feet sink 0.15 m, cars ignore curb).

Setbacks are layout data (Building.upper_tiers) and the building collider becomes one compound per tiered building. Rejected: visual-only tiers over a full-envelope cuboid (invisible walls around towers for camera cast, later bullets).

Mesh-merge gate lives in the client crate (cargo test -p gta_like, headless App with the production CityVisualsPlugin). Rejected: gate in gta_sim, which cannot see Mesh3d without violating the no-render boundary.

Every render chunk carries its own asphalt rectangle, so all ceil(size/chunk)^2 chunks are non-empty by construction. Rejected: clipping block surfaces per chunk (more code) and skipping empty chunks (count becomes layout-dependent).

Sky = unlit vertex-colour gradient dome following the camera + ClearColor = fog colour. Rejected: bevy_pbr Atmosphere (needs Hdr, RAW_SUNLIGHT + Exposure retune of all lighting, untested with DistanceFog).

tools/fetch_assets.py (stdlib Python, tiny RON subset reader) downloads and extracts; the strict validator is the Rust test in gta_sim with sha2 0.10.9 dev-dep. Rejected: Rust fetch tool (needs zip + HTTP crates offline).

gitignore: use '/assets/third_party/*' + '!/assets/third_party/manifest.ron', not the literal '/assets/third_party/' from TASK_FINAL; probe showed the literal form silently ignores the manifest too (git cannot re-include a file under an excluded dir).

Manifest schema lives once in gta_sim::config::manifest (serde only, no new normal deps) and is shared by the gta_sim gate and the client startup preflight; rejected: test-local types in the gate plus a second copy in main.rs (two schemas drift).

Client startup preflight checks presence of every manifest file and that render.ron prop paths are manifest files; hashes are checked by the gta_sim gate and fetch_assets.py --check. Rejected: SHA-256 at game startup (adds sha2 to the client for a case the gate already covers).

Merge-gate completeness uses an independent roof-corner vertex check per building in the chunk the test derives itself; CityChunk.buildings counter dropped. Rejected: sum of the self-reported counter (moves with the defect).
City spawn is applied with a cursor (chunks_per_frame, props_per_frame in render.ron) per PLAN_V2; rejected PLAN.md's single-frame spawn_batch with measure-then-slice.
Client container fit needs citygen::contains_convex; re-exported it from gta_sim::world instead of adding a direct citygen dependency to the gta_like crate.
Road markings kept inside city_mesh.rs (421 lines, under the 750 warning) instead of a separate city_markings.rs; a split would need the private MeshBuilder/Chunks to leak.
rustfmt on crates/citygen/src/lib.rs reformats child modules recursively and touched the untouched roads.rs; reverted with git checkout. Format leaf files only.

t3 roof overview: player teleported 4.5 m from roof centre (inside the >=6 m top-tier half extent for any tower yaw) and OrbitCamera yaw/pitch set over BRP (pitch -45 deg), instead of the review's literal 'move to the roof edge' (edge position unknown without tower yaw; risk of falling off). Pitch -25 tried first: roof still filled the lower half.
Roof frame cost measured with PresentMode::AutoNoVsync set over BRP world.mutate_components (2.5 ms avg) instead of reporting the Fifo t3 number (59 FPS = display refresh, window unfocused).
